\bibitem[Atiyah and Bott(1984)]{AtiyahBott1984}
M.~F. Atiyah and R.~Bott.
\newblock The moment map and equivariant cohomology.
\newblock \emph{Topology}, 23\penalty0 (1):\penalty0 1--28, 1984.
\newblock URL
  \url{https://www.math.stonybrook.edu/~mmovshev/MAT570Spring2008/BOOKS/atiyahbott_moment.pdf}.
\newblock Verified in this writing on 18 November 2026 at these loci only.
  Original Topology23(1984): Theorem3.5 p8;\allowbreak{} complete equivariant Euler-class
  argument, equations3.7 and3.8 p9. Scope: Read and visually opened both
  original printed pages8–9. The push-pull i* i\_* is multiplication by the
  equivariant Euler class;\allowbreak{} the normal representation has no fixed vectors, and
  its degree-zero-in-the-base Euler factor is the product of its nonzero
  weights. Localizing in those weights gives the explicit inverse sum of
  restriction divided by Euler class and the integration formula(3.8). This
  opens the exact localization formula used for the characteristic ledger;\allowbreak{} it
  assigns no proof credit to the individual ledger entries. PDF SHA256
  ccdb6befb9f6bed8397f78e88db2f41bce77635819f79164724228356c56d521 Exact
  author/title/publication identity. Current reading credit is confined to the
  stated original-edition loci.
